# Set Up

```{r}
# Libraries
library("tidyverse")
library("gt")
library("here")
library("patchwork")
library("lubridate")
library("glue")
library("dlnm"); library("gnm")

# ggplot2 theming
theme_set(theme_classic())
theme_update(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             strip.background = element_blank(),
             strip.text = element_text(size = 12))
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Read in the data."

# Get base data
df <- read_csv(here("data", "merged_data_by_age.csv")) |> 
  filter(!(city_name %in% c("Belo Horizonte", "Campinas")))

# Data frame with only unique entries of modifiers
df1 <- df |> 
  select(!c(age_category, year, date, death, popwt_temp)) |> 
  summarize(across(everything(), first), .by = nbhd_geoid)

glimpse(df)
glimpse(df1)
```


# Exploratory Data Analysis

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Create count table."

df |> 
  summarize(across(everything(), n_distinct), .by = city_name) |> 
  select(-c(city_geoid, iso2)) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Unique Observations for Each City")
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Histograms of variable values per day by city."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4

make_histogram <- function(variable = "death") {
  df |>  
    slice_sample(n = 10000, by = c(age_category, city_name)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(!!sym(variable), fill = age_category)) +
    geom_histogram() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) {x/1000}) +
    facet_grid(age_category ~ city_name) 
}

make_histogram("death")

make_histogram("popwt_temp")

make_histogram("pct_green")

make_histogram("pct_primary")

make_histogram("pop_density")

```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Bar chart."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4

df |> 
  summarize(death = sum(death), .by = age_category) |> 
  ggplot(aes(age_category, death)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Age Category", y = "Total Deaths", title = "Deaths by Age Category")
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Correlation plots of modifiers."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

# Basic Pair Plots
df1 |> 
  select(pct_green, pct_primary, pop_density) |> 
  GGally::ggpairs()

# Pair Plots with Color by Country
df1 |> 
  GGally::ggpairs(columns = c("pct_green", "pct_primary", "pop_density"), 
                  aes(color = iso2, alpha = .2))

# Pair Plots with Color by City
df1 |> 
  GGally::ggpairs(columns = c("pct_green", "pct_primary", "pop_density"), 
                  aes(color = city_name, alpha = .2))
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Correlation plots."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

# Create plots
list_cor_plots <-
  pmap(list(name = city_names,
            df = list_df),
       \(name, df) {
         map2(c("pct_green",   "pct_green",    "pct_educated"), 
              c("pop_density", "pct_educated", "pop_density"),
              \(var1, var2) {
                df |>
                  summarize(across(everything(), first), .by = c(nbhd_geoid)) |>
                  ggplot(aes(.data[[var1]], .data[[var2]])) +
                  geom_point() +
                  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
                  ggpubr::stat_cor(label.x = 80, aes(label = after_stat(r.label))) +
                  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
                  labs(title = name, x = var_names[[var1]], y = var_names[[var2]])
              }) |> set_names(c("cor1", "cor2", "cor3"))
  })



# Display pct_green and pop_density
wrap_plots(map(list_cor_plots, \(x) x$cor1), ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Correlation plots."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6


# Display pct_green and pct_educated
wrap_plots(map(list_cor_plots, \(x) x$cor2), ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Correlation plots."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6


# Display pop_density and pct_educated
wrap_plots(map(list_cor_plots, \(x) x$cor3), ncol = 2)
```



```{r}
#| code-summary: "Scatter plot of modifiers and death."

# Association of Modifiers with Death
df2 <- df |> drop_na()
n_sample <- 10000

df2 |> 
  slice_sample(n = n_sample) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pct_green, death, fill = age_category)) +
  geom_jitter(shape = 21)

df2 |> 
  slice_sample(n = n_sample) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pct_primary, death, fill = age_category)) +
  geom_jitter(shape = 21)

df2 |> 
  slice_sample(n = n_sample) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pop_density, death, fill = age_category)) +
  geom_jitter(shape = 21)

df2 |> 
  slice_sample(n = n_sample) |> 
  ggplot(aes(popwt_temp, death, fill = age_category)) +
  geom_jitter(shape = 21)
```

# Spatial Plots
```{r}
#| code-summary: "Generate spatial plots."

spatial_plot <- function(sf, variable, color_direction = 1) {
  fill_range <- range(df_nbhd_meta[[variable]])
  city_name <- sf$city_name
  
  sf |> 
    left_join(df_nbhd_meta, by = "nbhd_geoid") |> 
    ggplot(aes(fill = !!sym(variable))) +
    geom_sf() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = fill_range, direction = color_direction) +
    labs(title = city_name)
}

create_plots <- function(variable, color_direction = 1) {
  spatial_plot(phl_sf, variable, color_direction) + 
    spatial_plot(rio_sf, variable, color_direction) + 
    spatial_plot(sao_sf, variable, color_direction) + 
    spatial_plot(gua_sf, variable, color_direction) + 
    spatial_plot(pan_sf, variable, color_direction) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") 
}
```
